description: This is a test class for the LDAPSyncService, specifically testing the deletion of local users who have been removed from the LDAP server. It includes setup functions, mocks, and multiple test cases covering different scenarios of LDAP user synchronization and deletion logic.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceDeleteUsersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing LDAP synchronization user deletion functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes fixture directory path before each test.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Tests the deletion of local users who are no longer present on the LDAP server.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Tests handling of LDAP users with duplicate usernames during deletion process.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Tests deletion behavior when some LDAP entries fail validation or have missing required attributes.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Creates a mocked EntryCollection object from LDAP entries and lookup settings for testing.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Generates mock LDAP entries based on provided usernames.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Produces LDAP entries with duplicate usernames for testing duplicate handling.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Creates LDAP entries with missing data to simulate failed validation cases.
